description: Asks whether comparison and subtraction distinguish adjacent Double payloads and signed zeros (declared IEEEDouble pair), how a declared IEEESingle compares with a declared IEEEDouble of the same decimal text, which special payloads (negative zero, NaN, infinities, denormals) an undeclared parameter admits and returns unchanged, and how the stored Single/Double fields compare with literals and CSng/CDbl. Fixture r-expr-1-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and loaded modules are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
